questions.question: Dr. Amrani must prepare a budget forecast for his practice. Dr. Bennani advises him to analyze expense items. According to good management practices, which item generally represents the largest initial investment?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Investment in medical equipment is the largest item. A dental chair and CBCT represent considerable sums.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will budget accordingly.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to optimize her practice's cash flow management. According to management principles, what is the first step for good cash flow management?
options: Establish a cash flow forecast table
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The cash flow forecast table allows anticipation of cash inflows and outflows. It's the basis of good management.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will prepare one.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must analyze his practice's profitability. Dr. Bennani suggests calculating the break-even point. What does this indicator measure?
options: The amount of the practice's debts
The minimum turnover to cover expenses
The number of patients to receive per month
The amount of investments to be made
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The break-even point is the minimum turnover to cover all expenses. Below it, you're making a loss.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will calculate it.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to evaluate her practice's financial performance. According to management indicators, which ratio is most relevant for measuring operational efficiency?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The gross margin measures the difference between turnover and direct costs. It's a key indicator of practice efficiency.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will analyze this margin.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a cash flow deficit. Dr. Bennani suggests several solutions. Which solution is most appropriate for a dental practice?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Negotiating payment terms allows you to manage cash flows without increasing expenses. It's a sustainable solution.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will contact my suppliers.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must analyze her practice's balance sheet. According to Article 10 of Law 9-88, what does the balance sheet's liabilities represent?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Liabilities represent debts and equity. It's the source of the practice's resources.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will examine the liabilities carefully.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani wishes to invest in a new CBCT scanner. Dr. Bennani advises him to calculate the return on investment. What elements should be taken into account?
options: The purchase price and expected benefits
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'ROI compares the cost of the investment to the benefits it generates. It's essential for decision-making.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will do this calculation.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must prepare her practice's income statement. According to Article 10, what does the income statement summarize?
options: The financial year's income and expenses
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The income statement summarizes the financial year's income and expenses. It determines the net result.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will analyze it.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage unpaid patient fees. According to Article 16, how should he treat these receivables?
options: Keep them at their nominal value
Declare them to the tax authorities
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Doubtful receivables must be subject to impairment provisions. This adjusts the value of assets.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will make provisions.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to analyze her practice's performance compared to competitors. According to management practices, which tool is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Benchmarking allows comparison of performance with similar practices. It's a strategic analysis tool.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will carry one out.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must evaluate his practice's liquidity. According to financial ratios, which indicator measures the ability to pay short-term debts?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The current ratio compares short-term assets to short-term debts. It's an indicator of immediate solvency.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will calculate it.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to optimize her consumables inventory management. According to good practices, which method is recommended?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The just-in-time method reduces storage costs and avoids overstocking. It's an efficient practice.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will adopt it.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage seasonal variation in activity. Dr. Bennani advises him to prepare a flexible budget. What is the advantage of this type of budget?
options: It allows adaptation to activity variations
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The flexible budget adjusts to activity variations. It allows better management of periods of high or low activity.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will prepare one.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to evaluate the value of her practice. According to valuation methods, which approach is commonly used for dental practices?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The turnover multiple method is commonly used for dental practices because it is simple and reflects the value of the patient base.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will explore this method.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a temporary cash flow difficulty. Dr. Bennani suggests using financing. Which solution is most suitable for a practice?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'A cash credit line allows you to meet temporary needs. It's flexible and suited to practices.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will talk to my bank about it.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must analyze the evolution of her turnover. According to management tools, which indicator measures business growth?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The annual growth rate measures the evolution of turnover from one financial year to another. It's an indicator of dynamism.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will calculate it.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage an increase in fixed costs. Dr. Bennani advises him to identify compressible items. Which approach is most effective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Negotiating supplier contracts reduces fixed costs without impacting care quality.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will renegotiate my contracts.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to create a management dashboard. According to good practices, what indicators should she include?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'A dashboard must include financial indicators (turnover, margin) and activity indicators (patients, occupancy rate).' Dr. Bennani: 'I will build mine.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage staff remuneration. According to HR practices, what is the best approach to motivate the team?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Profit-sharing motivates the team by making them participants in the practice's results.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will study this option.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to analyze the composition of her turnover. According to revenue analysis, what is the main item for a dental practice?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Prosthetics often represent the main item in dental practice turnover, with high value-added procedures.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will analyze my turnover breakdown.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a decline in activity. Dr. Bennani advises him to diversify his offerings. Which diversification is most relevant for a dental practice?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Orthodontics is a relevant diversification that helps retain young patients and their families.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will train in orthodontics.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to optimize appointment management. According to good practices, which tool is most effective?
options: A scheduling software with automatic reminders
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Scheduling software with automatic reminders reduces no-shows and optimizes occupancy rates.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will invest in this software.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a conflict with a supplier over unpaid invoices. Dr. Bennani advises him to review payment terms. What is the best approach?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Negotiating a payment schedule resolves the conflict while preserving the commercial relationship.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will propose a schedule.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to evaluate her team's performance. According to HR practices, which tool is most appropriate?
options: An individual interview with clear objectives
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The individual interview with clear objectives motivates the team and aligns efforts with the practice's strategy.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will organize these interviews.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani, after implementing rigorous management, receives congratulations from Dr. Bennani. What is the next step for Dr. Amrani?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Practice succession is a key step that requires anticipation and financial preparation.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will start preparing my succession.'
